# hetznerrobot_subnet (Resource)

An IPv4 or IPv6 subnet of a server, adopted to manage its traffic warnings. Subnets cannot be created here (order one with `hetznerrobot_server_addon_order`). Destroying the resource only forgets the subnet; cancel it with `hetznerrobot_subnet_cancellation`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hetznerrobot_subnet" "v6" {
  ip               = "2a01:4f8:111:4221::"
  traffic_warnings = true
  traffic_monthly  = 20 # GB
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) Net address of the subnet, e.g. `2a01:4f8:111:4221::`.

### Optional

- `traffic_daily` (Number) Daily traffic limit in MB that triggers a warning.
- `traffic_hourly` (Number) Hourly traffic limit in MB that triggers a warning.
- `traffic_monthly` (Number) Monthly traffic limit in GB that triggers a warning.
- `traffic_warnings` (Boolean) Whether Robot sends traffic warnings.

### Read-Only

- `failover` (Boolean) Whether the subnet is a failover subnet.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway of the subnet.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the subnet is locked.
- `mask` (Number) Prefix length.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of the server the subnet is routed to.
- `server_number` (Number) Server the subnet belongs to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_subnet.v6 2a01:4f8:111:4221::
```
